parameters.query: INSERT INTO crawl_runs (source_url, status) VALUES ($1, 'running') RETURNING crawl_run_id, source_url;

UPDATE crawl_runs
SET status = 'completed',
    products_found = (SELECT count(*) FROM loan_products WHERE crawl_run_id = $1),
    finished_at = now()
WHERE crawl_run_id = $1;
UPDATE crawl_runs SET status = 'failed', error = $2, finished_at = now() WHERE crawl_run_id = $1;
